correctness.rationale: The proof independently establishes exact unary core/leaf predicates, the five permanent two-pebble pair-extension tables, three-variable definability of each fixed directed core walk length, the k-variable local predicate for at least k leaf children by shadowing the original root and testing siblings, and the fiberwise fixed-rotation k-pebble invariant when leaf counts are clipped at k. Burnside enumeration and unique minimum representatives follow directly. Boundary cases loop (length one), mutual two-cycle (length two), first nonadjacent core pair (length four), and k=3 root-recycling were checked. Two executable standard-library tests replay and corroborate only finitely many instances; they are not substituted for the general proof.

originality.rationale: Actual semantic and literature searches found no equal or dominating complete counting-free unrestricted-depth classification of positive leaf-decorated directed cycles by clipped cyclic words. Brown--Hoshino classify finite-round Ehrenfeucht--Fraisse equivalence of undirected paths/cycles, not k-variable unlimited-depth directed decorated cycles. Dawar--Holm characterize fixed-variable games abstractly but provide no cyclic-leaf classification. Earlier related mathematical work treated uncoloured sunlets at rank four, directed plain cycles at finite quantifier rank, and general connected functional digraphs under strictly stronger counting logic C²; none yields the five FO² phases or k-clipped necklace condition. A generic stronger theorem on finite unary algebras remains a genuine but non-decisive residual priority risk.
residual_risks: A broader model-theoretic characterization of monounary relational digraphs could imply this theorem without matching terminology.

value.rationale: The natural transition-system class comprises all finite connected height-one functional digraphs with a single directed recurrent orbit and at least one transient incoming leaf at every recurrent vertex. The theorem gives an exact unbounded logical equivalence relation for all positive cyclic branching patterns and every variable width, with exceptional one/two-variable collapses, complete k-ary necklace enumeration, and unique canonical smallest representatives. The k-child detectability by recycling the anchored variable resolves a genuine k versus k-1 expressiveness issue rather than a cosmetic case count. The scope is a meaningful naturally closed cyclic-leaf family, not an arbitrary finite parameter slice.
